name: PPL Log Analysis
description: Generate a PPL query for a service, fetch logs from OpenSearch, and produce a root-cause analysis with log interpretation guidance.

steps.objective: Generate a PPL query scoped to the target service using the provided labels and time window.
Fetch logs from OpenSearch using the generated PPL query and produce a root-cause analysis with log interpretation guidance.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 start of the time window (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

end_time.description: ISO 8601 end of the time window (e.g. 2024-01-01T01:00:00Z)

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to fetch (default 100)

objective.description: Optional analysis objective to focus the root-cause investigation
